ambient.text: I lost my book yesterday. I was reading it at the time.
My umbrella works great in the sun.
I'm late for my early meeting.
I bought a new phone so I could stare at it more efficiently.
I'm on a diet. Only snacks that glow in the dark.
My smart watch told me to relax. Now I'm stressed about relaxing.
I came out for fresh air. It's mostly neon.
I set ten alarms and still woke up on time. Weird.
I'm walking slowly so I can be late in style.
I tried to go to bed early. The city said no.
My cat has more followers than I do.
I'm saving money by window shopping. Every single window.
They said it would rain. It is, but only on me.
I always carry sunglasses. For the billboards.
I'm not lost. I'm exploring very confidently.
Nice car. Mine is a bicycle with dreams.
Did you see that? Me neither, it was too fast.
I left my keys at home. Which is fine. I live on the bus.
This crosswalk is my cardio.
Wow, a quiet night in the city. Said nobody, ever.
I came to the big crossing to meet a friend. All ten thousand of them.
I've been waiting for the green light since lunch.
The giant screen said smile. So I'm smiling. Professionally.
I love crowds. Especially when they go home.
Every sign here is shouting, and I'm whispering back.
I came for ramen and stayed for three more ramens.
The lights are so bright I can read my mind.
Karaoke at midnight is just yelling with a schedule.
The docks are peaceful. Except for everything.
I work in shipping. I ship myself home every night.
That container has been here so long it has a mailbox.
I climbed the tower once. The elevator did most of it.
From the top you can see the whole city. And my apartment. Still messy.
I'm afraid of heights, so I only look at the tower from below.
It's quiet here. Even the vending machines whisper.
My neighbour waters his plastic flowers every morning.
I moved here for the cherry trees. They're very punctual.
I came to the beach to get away from sand at home.
Perfect night for a tan. Moon tan.
I built a sandcastle. Rent is still too high.
The sea is great. Very wet, though.
I'm on vacation. From my vacation.
I brought sunscreen for the night. You can never be too careful.
Careful driving! I just got these shoes.
I'm an influencer. I influence pigeons, mostly.
Is that Ana? I heard she drives faster than the news.
Hi Ana! Love the haircut!
Traffic is terrible. I love it. It's like a parade that honks.

scared.text: Somebody call a taxi, but a slower one!
Whoa! I'm writing a strongly worded letter!

banter.text: Ana, that was a red light. I think. It was very fast.
This city never sleeps. Neither do we, apparently.
Can we stop for ramen after this?
Hold on, I know a shortcut.
Your shortcuts are always longer, Ana.
Nice driving. My heart rate disagrees.
Daniel, stop pressing the imaginary brake.

ja.text: 昨日、本をなくしちゃった。読んでる途中だったのに。
ja.en: I lost my book yesterday. I was in the middle of it.

ja.text: 今日はいい天気だね。夜だけど。
ja.en: Nice weather today. Even though it's night.

ja.text: ラーメン食べたいな。さっき食べたけど。
ja.en: I want ramen. I just had some, though.

ja.text: 早めに出たのに、また遅刻しそう。
ja.en: I left early, and I'm still going to be late.

ja.text: 傘を持ってきたら、雨がやんじゃった。
ja.en: I brought an umbrella, so the rain stopped.

ja.text: このあたり、ネオンで夜が明るすぎるね。
ja.en: The neon makes the night way too bright around here.

ja.text: スマホの充電、あと一パーセント。ドキドキする。
ja.en: One percent battery left. So exciting.

ja.text: 今夜は早く寝るつもり。たぶん。
ja.en: I'm going to bed early tonight. Probably.

ja.text: かっこいい車だね！気をつけて運転してね。
ja.en: Cool car! Drive safely, okay?

ja.text: コンビニに行ったら、欲しいものが全部あった。困る。
ja.en: The convenience store had everything I wanted. Dangerous.

ja.text: あれ、アナさんだ！こんばんは！
ja.en: Oh, it's Ana! Good evening!

ja.text: アナさんの車、今日もピカピカだね。
ja.en: Ana's car is shiny again today.

ja.text: この交差点、何回渡っても迷っちゃう。
ja.en: No matter how many times I cross here, I get lost.

ja.text: 大きな画面、ずっと見ちゃうね。
ja.en: I can't stop looking at the giant screen.

ja.text: 灯町のラーメン屋さん、全部行ってみたい。
ja.en: I want to try every ramen shop in Akari-cho.

ja.text: カラオケで歌いすぎて、声がなくなりそう。
ja.en: I sang so much karaoke I might lose my voice.

ja.text: 港の風、気持ちいいね。
ja.en: The breeze from the harbour feels nice.

ja.text: あのコンテナ、ずっと同じ場所にあるね。
ja.en: That container has been in the same spot forever.

ja.text: タワーの上から見る夜景、最高だよ。
ja.en: The night view from the top of the tower is the best.

ja.text: エレベーターが速すぎて、耳がびっくりした。
ja.en: The elevator was so fast my ears were surprised.

ja.text: 桜台は静かで、落ち着くね。
ja.en: Sakuradai is quiet and relaxing.

ja.text: 自販機と話してたら、もう夜中だった。
ja.en: I was chatting with the vending machine and now it's midnight.

ja.text: 夜の海もきれいだね。
ja.en: The sea is beautiful at night too.

ja.text: 砂のお城を作ったけど、波に持っていかれた。
ja.en: I built a sandcastle, but the waves took it.

ja.text: 夏が終わっても、ビーチは楽しいよ。
ja.en: Even after summer, the beach is fun.

ja.text: サンダルの中、砂だらけ。
ja.en: My sandals are full of sand.
